steps.html: Open claude.ai/settings/connectors
Click Add custom connector
Name it Speak AI, paste the URL above, click Add
steps.alt: Claude add custom connector dialog with Speak AI filled in

steps.html: Sign in to Speak AI, click Allow on the permission popup
steps.alt: Speak AI connected in Claude with tools listed

installs.title: Claude Desktop
installs.tagline: Native app for macOS and Windows.

steps.html: Open Claude Desktop → Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector
Paste the URL from the top of this page
Click Add, sign in to Speak AI, click Allow on the permission popup

devAlt.summary: Prefer manual setup with an API key?
devAlt.html: Expand Custom headers in the Add Connector dialog and add Authorization = Bearer <your-key>. Generate a key at app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys.

installs.title: ChatGPT
installs.tagline: Web and desktop. Install from ChatGPT's plugin directory.

steps.html: Open Speak AI in ChatGPT while signed in to ChatGPT
Click Install plugin
ChatGPT opens a new tab to Speak AI — sign in (or click Confirm if already logged in) to authorize
Return to ChatGPT — Speak AI is now in your apps list
Per-chat: open a chat, click the + menu, enable Speak AI for that chat

items: If the authorization tab lands on the plain Speak AI dashboard with no confirmation message, the authorization still went through — close that tab and return to ChatGPT.
If the install keeps reopening the dashboard, fully close and reopen ChatGPT, then check Settings → Apps & Connectors. Speak AI should already be listed there.
If a chat shows "no actions available," confirm Speak AI is enabled in the per-chat + menu.

If you can't install plugins in your ChatGPT account, ask your ChatGPT admin to allow Speak AI, or add it as a custom connector instead: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → turn on Developer Mode, click Create, paste the URL above and choose OAuth.

installs.title: Cursor
installs.tagline: One-click install, or a config file entry, then browser sign-in.

steps.html: Click the button, or add the config below to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (every project) or .cursor/mcp.json (one project)
Open Cursor Settings, then Tools & MCP. Speak AI shows that it needs a login; click it
Your browser opens Speak AI's sign-in page. Sign in, or create an account if you don't have one, then click Allow
Click the button — VS Code registers and opens the permission popup
Sign in to Speak AI and click Allow

installs.title: Windsurf
installs.tagline: Add Speak AI to a config file with your API key.

steps.html: Get your API key at app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys
Add the config below to ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json
Restart Windsurf. The Speak AI tools appear in the Cascade panel

installs.title: ChatGPT API / Responses
installs.tagline: For developers calling the Responses API directly.

code.lead: Pass your API key in the tool config of your Responses API call:

installs.title: Claude Code
installs.tagline: Add the hosted connector and sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Add the connector: claude mcp add --transport http speakai https://api.speakai.co/v1/mcp. Add --scope user to use it in every project
Sign in: claude mcp login speakai, or type /mcp inside Claude Code, pick speakai and choose to authenticate
Your browser opens Speak AI's sign-in page. Sign in, or create an account if you don't have one, then click Allow
No browser on this machine, for example over SSH? Run claude mcp login speakai --no-browser, open the printed link on another device, and paste the address your browser ends on back into the terminal

devAlt.summary: Prefer the plugin, or an API key?
devAlt.html:
The plugin adds the same hosted connector plus Speak AI skills: /plugin marketplace add claude-plugins-official, /plugin install speakai@claude-plugins-official, /reload-plugins, then /mcp to sign in.

To send an API key instead of signing in, append --header "Authorization: Bearer $SPEAKAI_KEY" to the add command.

items: Run claude mcp login speakai again, or type /mcp and authenticate speakai.
Check the connection with claude mcp get speakai.
Plugin install didn't find Speak AI? Refresh the catalog with /plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official, then retry.

installs.title: Codex
installs.tagline: Add the hosted connector from the Codex CLI and sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Add the connector: codex mcp add speakai --url https://api.speakai.co/v1/mcp
Codex sees that Speak AI uses browser sign-in and opens Speak AI's sign-in page right away. Sign in, or create an account if you don't have one, then click Allow
If the browser did not open, or you closed it before finishing, run codex mcp login speakai
Check it worked: codex mcp list shows OAuth in the Auth column for speakai

devAlt.html: Set SPEAKAI_KEY in your shell, then run codex mcp add speakai --url https://api.speakai.co/v1/mcp --bearer-token-env-var SPEAKAI_KEY.

installs.title: OpenClaw
installs.tagline: Use Speak AI as a skill in OpenClaw-compatible agents.

steps.html: Visit the Speak AI skill page on ClawHub
Follow the install instructions for your agent — e.g. clawhub install speakai from the ClawHub CLI
Set your SPEAK_API_KEY environment variable. Generate one at app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys

installs.title: Muse
installs.tagline: Meta's personal AI assistant. One-click sign-in, no API key.

steps.html: Open muse.ai and sign in
Ask your Muse to connect to Speak AI, for example "Connect to the Speak AI MCP server at https://api.speakai.co/v1/mcp"
Sign in to Speak AI, then click Allow on the permission popup. Muse uses the one-click OAuth flow, so there is no API key to paste
Confirm it worked by asking "Summarize my most recent recording in Speak AI"

Directory listing, pending approval: once Speak AI is approved in the Muse connector directory, you will find Speak AI in Muse's directory and connect in one click, with no URL to paste. This step replaces the two above it when that lands.

installs.title: Gemini CLI
installs.tagline: Google's command line assistant. Add Speak AI with one command, then sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Add the connector: gemini mcp add --transport http speakai https://api.speakai.co/v1/mcp
Start Gemini CLI and type /mcp auth speakai
Your browser opens Speak AI's sign-in page. Sign in, or create an account if you don't have one, then click Allow
Sign-in needs a browser on the same machine. Over SSH, use an API key instead (below)

devAlt.html: Add --header "Authorization: Bearer $SPEAKAI_KEY" to the add command. Generate a key at app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys.

installs.title: GitHub Copilot CLI
installs.tagline: GitHub Copilot in your terminal. Add Speak AI with your API key.

steps.html: Get your API key at app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys
Add the config below to ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json, or type /mcp add inside Copilot CLI
Copilot CLI picks up the server without a restart. On Copilot Business or Enterprise, an admin must turn on the MCP servers in Copilot policy

installs.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio
installs.tagline: Give your Copilot Studio agents access to your Speak AI recordings and insights.

steps.html: Open your agent, go to Tools, choose Add a tool, then New tool, then Model Context Protocol
Name it Speak AI, add a short description, and paste the URL above as the server URL
For authentication choose OAuth 2.0, then Dynamic discovery, and select Create
Select Create a new connection, sign in to Speak AI and click Allow, then Add to agent. Your Power Platform data policies must allow the connector

installs.title: Zed
installs.tagline: The Zed editor. Add Speak AI in settings, then sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Open Settings, then AI, then MCP Servers. Select Add Server, then Add Remote Server
Paste the URL above, or add the config below to your settings file (zed: open settings file)
With no Authorization header, Zed opens Speak AI's sign-in page. Sign in, then click Allow

installs.title: Goose
installs.tagline: The open source AI agent. Install Speak AI with one click, then sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Click the button. Goose opens and asks to add the Speak AI extension
Confirm, then sign in to Speak AI when your browser opens and click Allow
No Goose desktop app? Open Extensions, choose Add custom extension, pick Streamable HTTP and paste the URL above

installs.title: opencode
installs.tagline: The opencode coding agent. Add Speak AI to its config, then sign in through your browser.

steps.html: Add the config below to your opencode config file (opencode.jsonc)
Run opencode mcp auth speakai, or type /mcps inside opencode and select speakai
Your browser opens Speak AI's sign-in page. Sign in, or create an account if you don't have one, then click Allow

installs.title: Mistral Le Chat
installs.tagline: Add Speak AI as a custom connector so Le Chat can search and read your recordings.

steps.html: Open Le Chat and go to the Connectors page
Click + Add Connector, then open the Custom MCP Connector tab
Enter a Connector name with no spaces or special characters, such as SpeakAI, and paste the URL above into Server URL
Click Connect. Le Chat detects the sign-in method itself. Sign in to Speak AI and click Allow
Optional: in My Connectors, open the Speak AI card and use the Functions tab to turn on Always allow for tools you use often
Only an account administrator can add connectors. On Free, Pro and Student plans that is the account owner

installs.title: Perplexity
installs.tagline: Add Speak AI as a custom connector so Perplexity can search and read your recordings.

steps.html: In Perplexity, open Plugins in the sidebar, choose Add custom, then Add MCP connector, and select Remote
Enter the name Speak AI and paste the URL above into MCP server URL
Open Advanced. Set Authentication to OAuth and Transport to Streamable HTTP, and leave Network access on Public
Tick the risk checkbox and click Add. Then select the Speak AI card, sign in to Speak AI and click Allow
Don't see Add custom? Your plan may not include custom connectors. On a work account, an administrator must turn on Allow members to add custom connectors
